name: consulting-tools
description: Adaptive, evidence-grounded consulting workflows with capability-aware execution.

interface.longDescription: Selects fit-for-purpose consulting methods, grounds current claims in evidence, and exposes only the executable capabilities available in the installed version. Deliverables adapt to the user's objective instead of forcing a fixed report template.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this business problem and choose the methods that actually add decision value.
Turn these materials into an evidence-grounded consulting deliverable for the intended audience.
Assess this opportunity, show the important uncertainties, and recommend defensible next actions.
